NACE loss differs from consequence loss, exact continuity survives Chroma loss, identity denial occurs before body admission, and meaning-preserving controls remain stable.

JavaScript launches processes, records outputs, and compares frozen expectations; it does not create the native standing. Fixture adapters totalize unavailable products but cannot translate them into a pass. The CStep and DRResume fixture limits are disclosed rather than promoted to runtime claims.

It used synthetic Mattermost identities and did not access live Mattermost, Keychain, Chroma, private memory, or personal content. No Miter core source changed.
fidelity_review.remaining_gaps: G33 must still prove a clean-start end-to-end organism under a separately frozen plan. R2 does not prove complete enactment of all five mathematical authorities, all nine flourishings, arbitrary cognition, live multi-user operation, universal exactly-once behavior, provider cancellation, or kernel containment.
